name: clean_go_map_with_mutex
title: Fetch prices concurrently
body: Price refresh took minutes for big catalogs. This fetches the SKUs concurrently with errgroup, at most 8 at a time (the price API allows 10 per client); the result map is guarded by a mutex.
diff:
### prices/all.go (modified, +25/-7)
@@ -1,20 +1,38 @@
 package prices
 
-import "context"
+import (
+	"context"
+	"sync"
+
+	"golang.org/x/sync/errgroup"
+)
 
 type Fetcher interface {
 	Price(ctx context.Context, sku string) (int64, error)
 }
 
-// All returns the price of every SKU, one call at a time.
+// All returns the price of every SKU, fetched concurrently.
 func All(ctx context.Context, f Fetcher, skus []string) (map[string]int64, error) {
 	out := make(map[string]int64, len(skus))
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	g, ctx := errgroup.WithContext(ctx)
+	// At most 8 calls in flight: the price API allows 10 per client.
+	g.SetLimit(8)
 	for _, sku := range skus {
-		p, err := f.Price(ctx, sku)
-		if err != nil {
-			return nil, err
-		}
-		out[sku] = p
+		sku := sku
+		g.Go(func() error {
+			p, err := f.Price(ctx, sku)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			mu.Lock()
+			out[sku] = p
+			mu.Unlock()
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	if err := g.Wait(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
 	}
 	return out, nil
 }
